data.one_liner: A lightweight Flutter UI library providing animation, progress, paging, input, and display widgets.
data.what_it_does: flutter_waya offers a collection of UI components categorized into core, animation, feedback, paging, input, display, and timing utilities. All public components use an 'Fl' prefix and are documented with Chinese comments.
use_when: You need lightweight custom UI components like specialized inputs, indicators, and animations.
You prefer UI components with built-in Chinese API documentation and comments.
avoid_when: You require comprehensive cross-platform UI system implementations like Material 3 or full Cupertino design systems.
You need components that were removed in version 12.0.0 (such as FlDraggableScrollbar or FlLiquidProgressIndicator).
strengths: Includes regression tests covering lifecycle and animation edge cases.
Consistent naming conventions with the 'Fl' prefix.
weaknesses: API documentation and comments are primarily in Chinese.
Several components were deprecated and removed in version 12.0.0.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import flutter_waya.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: For standard Google Material Design components.
